question: Validate complete per-phase native/backend instruction counting and size the cold cost/compression driver on disjoint control curves.

claims.text: Every admitted pilot cell has a checked one-target outcome and all ROI instructions assigned exactly once, with independent counter and finite-output replay.
Sizing only: no comparison on unequal queries, held-out, whole-IC, calibrated GAE, timing, novelty or NIST claim.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No comparative population or performance verdict in this sizing pilot. Matched ordinary bases, ambiguity/cycle synthetic controls and zero/unassigned-counter negative tests are present.

primary.definition: Sum all exclusive native and actual resident-GP ROI intervals from setup to source verification; no launch/input/fixture/result-file work.

decision_rule.text: Admit only fully bound valid counters and checked finite results; use elapsed/resource data solely to size later runs, no speed ranking.
decision_rule.statistic: All ROI assignments exact, independent raw sums and finite group/matrix checks.
decision_rule.interval: A/A observed range only; not a confidence interval.
